description: This source file (utf8.c) provides various utility functions for handling UTF-8 encoded strings, including width calculation, BOM detection, encoding conversions, and string wrapping. It appears to be part of a larger project dealing with text processing or source code manipulation, with a focus on Unicode and UTF-8 handling.

methods.name: size_t display_mode_esc_sequence_len(const char * s)
methods.description: Determines the length of an ANSI escape sequence at the start of a string, used for terminal display formatting.

methods.name: int bisearch(ucs_char_t ucs,const struct interval * table,int max)
methods.description: Performs a binary search over a table of Unicode intervals, used internally for width calculations.

methods.name: int git_wcwidth(ucs_char_t ch)
methods.description: Calculates the display width of a Unicode character, considering wide and zero-width characters.

methods.name: ucs_char_t pick_one_utf8_char(const char ** start,size_t * remainder_p)
methods.description: Extracts a single UTF-8 character from a string, updating the pointer and handling invalid sequences.

methods.name: int utf8_width(const char ** start,size_t * remainder_p)
methods.description: Returns the display width of a UTF-8 character, updating the string pointer.

methods.name: int utf8_strnwidth(const char * string,size_t len,int skip_ansi)
methods.description: Calculates the total display width of a UTF-8 string, considering formatting and validity.

methods.name: int utf8_strwidth(const char * string)
methods.description: Gets the display width of a null-terminated UTF-8 string.

methods.name: int is_utf8(const char * text)
methods.description: Checks whether a string is valid UTF-8.

methods.name: void strbuf_add_indented_text(struct strbuf * buf,const char * text,int indent,int indent2)
methods.description: Adds indented text to a buffer, processing newline characters.

methods.name: void strbuf_add_wrapped_text(struct strbuf * buf,const char * text,int indent1,int indent2,int width)
methods.description: Wraps and adds text to a buffer with specified indentation and width constraints.

methods.name: void strbuf_add_wrapped_bytes(struct strbuf * buf,const char * data,int len,int indent,int indent2,int width)
methods.description: Wraps byte data and adds it to a buffer with indentation.

methods.name: void strbuf_utf8_replace(struct strbuf * sb_src,int pos,int width,const char * subst)
methods.description: Replaces part of a string buffer with a substitution, considering UTF-8 character widths.

methods.name: int same_utf_encoding(const char * src,const char * dst)
methods.description: Determines if two encoding names are equivalent, accounting for various UTF variants.

methods.name: int is_encoding_utf8(const char * name)
methods.description: Checks if the given encoding name represents UTF-8.

methods.name: int same_encoding(const char * src,const char * dst)
methods.description: Checks if two encoding names are equivalent, defaulting to UTF-8 if null.

methods.name: int utf8_fprintf(FILE * stream,const char * format,...)
methods.description: Formats and prints a UTF-8 string to a file stream, returning display width.

methods.description: Converts a string from one encoding to another using iconv, handling BOMs.

methods.description: Returns length in bytes of next multibyte character, supporting UTF-8 and other encodings.
